subject: Nuvida tailored onramp waiver — authorization request
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nuvida.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, DevOps Team <infra@nuvida.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation and pilot scope

Ben —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. We like Redwood's latency profile and the batching recommendations, but the initial pilot footprint is larger than we expected. Before we commit to the POC, procurement asked if you can support a 3-month ramp with a 40% onboarding credit on token usage and waived private VPC setup fees.

We are ready to sign a 12-month commitment after the pilot if the onramp helps us prove unit economics quickly. Can you let me know if this is within scope?

—Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform, Nuvida
olivia.chen@nuvida.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nuvida.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation and pilot scope

Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and for the candid timeline. Short answer: we can get close but need internal approval for the scale you outlined.

Quick summary of what we can propose pending sign-off:
- 3-month onboarding credit equal to 35% of billed tokens (applied as a monthly credit)
- Waive the initial private VPC setup fee (one-time)
- Condition: a 12-month MRR commitment that starts at month 4 with a minimum monthly usage floor of $20k (to be carved in the contract)

I've attached a proposed mutual action plan and the pricing worksheet for your review (nuvida-proposed-onramp-pricing-20270519.pdf, muap). If this structure looks reasonable, I'll escalate for VP/CFO signoff today.

Next steps: let me know which items are must-haves vs negotiable.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nuvida-proposed-onramp-pricing-20270519.pdf; nuvida-muap-20270519.xlsx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:26:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood evaluation and pilot scope — request for VP/CFO approval

Folks — forwarding Ben's proposed structure. Nuvida is a strategic mid-market prospect with a clean exec sponsor; they will likely expand quickly in Q4 if the pilot proves out.

Requesting Marissa and finance signoff on a limited exception for the onramp: 35% token credit for 3 months (applied monthly) + one-time waiver of VPC setup, in exchange for a 12-month commitment with $20k/mo floor starting month 4. This is below our standard onboarding credit cap.

Key risk notes:
- If they churn after month 6 we need a clawback clause — propose a pro-rata recoup over 9 months.
- We should preserve the right to fall back to hosted API variants if private infra costs exceed estimate.

I've attached the MUAP and the cost model. Ben: please add expected initial monthly spend and the infra estimate by EOD.

Thanks —Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood evaluation and pilot scope — request for VP/CFO approval

Thanks for the quick summary. I reviewed the model and spoke briefly with finance. Approve the exception with these stipulations:

- Approve 35% onboarding credit for 3 months (not to exceed $150k total credit)
- Waive VPC setup fee once; if we need custom networking beyond standard offering, Nuvida covers excess costs
- Add a 9-month clawback amortization (if customer cancels before month 12 we recoup remaining credit over the next 9 billing cycles)
- Require legal to include the usage floor and auto-conversion clause in the SOW — no verbal commitments

Please document the approval in HubSpot and attach the signed SOW once countersigned. This approval is conditional on getting the projected month-4 usage estimate and a short note from infra confirming setup complexity.

Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nuvida.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation and pilot scope

Olivia — great news, we have conditional approval from our VP/CFO. Summary of agreed points (final SOW to follow):

- 35% onboarding credit applied monthly for first 3 months (cap $150k)
- One-time waiver of standard VPC setup fee; any custom network engineering beyond our standard offering will be invoiced separately
- 12-month commitment starts month 4 with a $20k/mo usage floor; legal will include a 9-month clawback amortization for the onboarding credit

Next steps: I'll get the SOW updated with the clauses Marissa requested and route for signatures. Expect the draft in your inbox tomorrow morning.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
